newsitem.title: UK: Algeria freezes Nov gas oil price - traders.
newsitem.headline: Algeria freezes Nov gas oil price - traders.

text.p: Algerian state oil company Sonatrach kept unchanged its low sulphur gas oil price in November, traders said on Wednesday.
They said Sonatrach maintained its $2.50 per tonne premium to the formula, which is based on diesel prices in northern Europe and the Mediterranean.
Traders said Sonatrach was expected to deliver five or six cargoes during the month.

One trader said the price was widely considered to be excessive but that several firms had accepted the figure because they sought to nurture long-term relationships with Sonatrach in a range of other activities.
"It's too high. There is a big gap between the proposed price and the announced price," the trader said.
